statement: let v := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ≤ X then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n else 0; let C := fun (X h : ℕ) => (Finset.range (X+1)).sum (fun n => v X n * v X (n+h)); RiemannHypothesis → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → |C X 0-((X:ℝ)*Real.log X-X)| ≤ K*Real.sqrt X*Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3
